notes.title: TOXIDRA Update – Broken Roads, Mutant Bugs and Triple Tongue
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.0.12 – TOXIDRA: cockroaches, octos and triple tongue [/h1][p]
[/p][h2]New Level 13: TOXIDRA [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880158/8bc2fa7e95ea647c5b624a16210ffab0bd558489.png"][/img]
Post-apocalyptic tourism at its finest:  

- 🛣️ Drive across shattered, flooded roads while picking your way through debris.  

- 🪳 New enemy: giant mutant cockroaches immune to bullets. The trick? Blow them up with nearby explosives—or dodge or die.  

- 🐙 Second enemy: massive mutant octopuses leaping out of the water straight at you. Luckily, bullets still work on these.  

- 👅 Grand finale: a hulking beast with **three tongues**—and none of them are for kissing. Each lash can flatten you into jelly.  

Does it sound deadly? Yes. Does it sound fun? Oh yes.  

[/p][h2] General improvements [/h2][p]
- Smoother, flashier animations.  

- Minor bug fixes for an even tighter experience.  

In short: broken roads, mutant bugs, and a three-tongued boss you’ll never forget.  [/p]

notes.title: CSMANTIS Update – Colossal Beasts, Giant Mantis and Global Rankings
notes.notes: [h2] New Level 12: CSMANTIS [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880158/6e8d0a345db190b06204f9c955023e5fa73c840d.png"][/img][/p][h2]Who needs a buggy when you can ride a living tank?  [/h2][list][*][p]🦏 A creature somewhere between a rhino and a hippo, so huge it feels like a war machine on legs.    [/p][/*][*][p]💣 You don’t run—you crush. Flatten enemies beneath your beast as you storm through the lair of a 5 meter mantis.    [/p][/*][*][p]🪳 The grand finale: A massive mantis boss ready to slice you into pieces unless you blast it first.    [/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]           Does it sound dangerous? Yes. Does it sound fun? Absolutely![/i][/b]    [/p][p][/p][h2] Leaderboards Expanded [/h2][list][*][p]Each level keeps its own ranking, but now there’s also a [b]global leaderboard[/b].    [/p][/*][*][p]It adds up your scores across all levels, so you can fight not just for stage dominance but for the title of best Echo Wars player in the world.    [/p][/*][/list][h2] Tougher enemies [/h2][list][*][p]Missile soldiers are now bigger, blue, and tougher: double the health for double the trouble.    [/p][/*][/list][h2] Rework of Level 7: Hipposaurus [/h2][list][*][p]💣 Bigger, crazier, and a lot more fun. [/p][/*][*][p]The final boss now puts up a serious fight.    [/p][/*][/list][h2] Other improvements [/h2][list][*][p]Improved force feedback when playing with a wheel on PC—you’ll feel every bump and crash.  [/p][/*][*][p]Level 6 (Space Race): easier to damage the boss and now prettier with visual polish.    [/p][/*][*][p]Level 5 (Flameworm): lighting fixed, no more playing in the dark.    [/p][p]In short: colossal beasts, giant bugs, global glory and an upgraded festival of chaos.   [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: SkyRage Update – Missiles, Chaos and a Colossal New Boss
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.0.10 – SkyRage: Missiles for Everyone! [/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880158/185cc52f0f6ab933b593807e746ec04ddfc1735e.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Level 11: SkyRage [/h2][p]Buckle up, because there are no brakes here:  
- 🚀 A level packed with speed and spectacular flights while fighting giant biped robots straight out of a sci-fi blockbuster.  
- 💥 You finally get your hands on the craziest weapon in the game: a rocket launcher. And you’re not alone—everyone is firing missiles like it’s a candy parade.  
- 🐉 The grand finale: a colossal four-legged monster you’ll have to chase at full speed across a lava-filled terrain until you bury it under an endless storm of rockets. Only the brave will taste glory.  

In short: destruction, chaos, and more missiles than you ever thought possible on one screen.  

[/p][h2]Improved Physics [/h2][p]- Crashing into other vehicles now feels even more fun and satisfying—every hit packs more punch.  
- Explosions are bigger, louder, and flashier than ever. More fire, more smoke, more spectacle.  

Get ready: what used to be a fireworks show is now the full-blown apocalypse in 4D.  [/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 – More languages, smarter beasts & bigger show
notes.notes:
[h2] Welcome to the multilingual club [/h2][p]We used to have English, Spanish, German and Catalan. Now we’ve added Brazilian Portuguese, French, Italian, Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean. If you still can’t understand the instructions… that’s on you.  

[/p][h2] Levels polished for extra fun [/h2][p]We gave several levels a serious tune-up:  
- Level 8 (Hipposaurus): the sea monsters that leap out are now smarter (just enough). They get closer, intimidate you, and make the whole level far more spectacular.  
- Level 7 (Dino Queen): the big dinos now move more naturally, and the boss fight has been rebalanced to be way more fun.  

[/p][h2] Streamer mode upgraded [/h2][p]The streamer camera on PC has been improved. Your broadcasts will look even more spectacular. Time to farm those epic clips.  

[/p][h2] Buggy screen upgrade [/h2][p]The buggy’s dashboard now shows the current level info more clearly. Less confusion, more action.  [/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 – Welcome to the Spider’s Lair
notes.notes: [h2]New Level 10: Arachnida[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880158/ce682063b09a9eee085d9d2af10eedfeaebe5fa6.png"][/img][/p][p]Get ready for something completely different: infiltrating a cave swarming with spiders. But not just any spiders…  [/p][p]- 🕷️ Giant black spiders: always asleep, but if touched they wake up. Bullets won’t kill them — only explosions can.  [/p][p]- 🤖 Small red mechanical spiders: also asleep. One hit and they chase you, the second hit makes them explode.  [/p][p]The trick is to use them wisely: lure the red ones near the black ones and turn the cave into a living minefield.  [/p][p]And topping it all off: a [b]40-meter boss spider[/b] you’ll have to chase while it spawns waves of baby spiders along the way. A challenge guaranteed to make your skin crawl.  [/p][h2]Leaderboards fixed [/h2][p]We found that records weren’t uploading correctly to the server. That’s now fixed. The good news: your local score was saved. Just replay the level once and your best result will be submitted.  [/p][h2]Surround sound upgrade [/h2][p]We improved the 3D audio system to take the real architecture of each level into account. You’ll notice it especially in cave sections, where the echo and reverb feel far more immersive.  [/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 – Demo boosted & fixes everywhere
notes.notes:
[h2] Demo gets serious [/h2]  
Until now the demo was just an appetizer with Level 1 (Bestiosaur). But we know you’re hungry, so now it also includes Level 9 (Batrachian). Two for the price of one: a starter and the main dish.  

[h2] Improved non-VR view [/h2]  
By default we now use the new first-person view with “anti-nausea” enabled. You can aim perfectly even if the car is spinning like a top. If you don’t like it, just change it in the options or press C to swap views.  

[h2] Inverted Y axis [/h2]  
A true classic. You can now invert the Y axis when playing without VR. Because there are two types of players: those who *don’t* invert the axis… and those who are wrong.  

[h2] Bugs squashed [/h2]  
We cleaned up all reported bugs. Highlights include:  
- Flight switches that sometimes ignored your shots.  
- Rocks in Level 5 that you could fly straight through (sorry, no ghost powers here).  

Plus some small tweaks to make everything feel tighter and less “ghost mode.”

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 – New Level, New Buggy, More Chaos
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Update 1.0.6 – BATRACHIAN Unleashed[/h1][p] [/p][h2]New Level: BATRACHIAN [/h2][p]Level 9 has arrived at last. Expect wild curves, intense climbs and drops, alien frogs leaping into action, and cinematic explosions everywhere. The finale? A boss immune to bullets that can only be defeated by turning the environment to your advantage. Ready for the challenge?  

[url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZcY0OJrDcJk"]
[/url][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880158/a453e3ef2e5cb6bffe973face012e5e09063d51c.png"][/img] [/p][h2]Buggy redesign [/h2][p]Goodbye to those roof bars that blocked your shots. Now you can aim freely at any angle without frustration. On top of that, your virtual body fits the seat better and only disappears if you move too much in real life, boosting immersion.  

[/p][h2] Smoother driving [/h2][p]The buggy now responds much better to the accelerator, allowing for gradual speed control. Yes, going slow is finally possible without frustration.  

[/p][h2] Tweaked slow-motion powerup [/h2][p]Slow time lasts a little less, but your weapon fires faster while it’s active. Less time, more action — making every use way more satisfying.  

[/p][h2] Bosses and levels reworked [/h2][p]We polished and improved several levels. Special mention to the boss of Level 5 (Flamewarm), which is now much more fun to fight.  

[/p][h2] Relax difficulty adjusted [/h2][p]Relax mode no longer means infinite lives. You now get 6. Still forgiving, still chill — but you can’t just nap your way through anymore.  

[/p][h2] Extra visual flair [/h2][p]Several levels have been optimized, with extra care for the native Quest 3 version. More effects, sharper visuals, and a bigger spectacle for your eyes.  

[/p][h2] Options that fit you [/h2][p]A new menu option lets you calibrate controller rotation however you prefer. Every player aims differently, and now the game adapts to you.  

[/p][h2] Explosions with improved shake [/h2][p]We refined the camera shake effects during explosions. Now every blast feels more powerful, more cinematic, and more epic than ever.  
[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 – Hold on tight
notes.notes:
[h2] Steering with style [/h2]  
Prefer driving with your hands instead of the stick? The wheel now responds much better to your movements. Plus, in the options you can choose between auto-magnet by proximity (default) or grip for more precise control.  

[h2] Final attack upgrade [/h2]  
The level 3 boss, “Chiropteran,” no longer beats around the bush: its final attack now makes it crystal clear you’re about to get crushed. At least there won’t be any doubt about what’s coming.  

[h2] Safer jumps [/h2]  
The jump platform switches now only react to your shots. Debris from other explosions won’t mess with them anymore. Less chaos, more control (but don’t get too comfortable).  

[h2] Friendlier buggy [/h2]  
We adjusted the position of your character inside the buggy. Small movements no longer make your body vanish so easily. Basically: you’re still there, even if you get a little jumpy.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Notes – Faster, Louder, Meaner
notes.notes:
[h2] Speed it up [/h2]  
The first 8 levels just got a serious tune-up: faster pacing, more chaos, and a whole lot more action. We also polished the little details so things feel smoother than ever. Thanks for all the feedback — that’s exactly why Early Access is worth it.  

[h2] Retry without regrets [/h2]  
Now, if you take down a boss after a retry, you won’t lose all your mission progress. Because re-fighting the same monster is punishment enough.  

[h2] Bosses with manners [/h2]  
We tweaked some bosses on normal difficulty. Special shoutout to the Methane Slug in level 2, who used to slap you around like it was training for the UFC. Now it only gets that nasty on higher difficulties. Good luck with that.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Notes – Survival Manual
notes.notes:
[h2] Stuck? Not anymore! [/h2]  
Before diving headfirst into each level, you’ll now see some handy tips that might just save your life (or at least your patience).  

[h2] Tips with a twist [/h2]  
* From “lower the difficulty and pretend it was your plan” to “ninjas can’t handle a good run-over.”  
* Yes, we also remind you that giant worms CANNOT be killed. (Seriously, stop trying).  
* And watch what you shoot: sometimes blasting the wrong thing disables your jump booster. That’s not a bug… it’s a tip.  

[h2] Why this update matters [/h2]  
Because now, when you fail, you can at least say: “Hey, the game did warn me!”.

notes.title: Quick Fix: Block 1 Unlock Bug Resolved
notes.notes:
Thanks to your feedback we’ve just released a quick fix that solves the issue where Block 1 could remain locked even if you had collected the required stars.

We really appreciate all the comments and reports you’re sharing — they’re helping us a lot. We’re already working on the first improvement pack, coming next week, based directly on the feedback we’re receiving. Stay tuned!
